lesson.title: Rebase a feature branch onto main

build.note: Test-only graph for the scripted git history path (fake Claude client).

steps.title: Inspect the two branches
steps.instructions: Run git log --oneline --graph --all and find where feature diverged from main.

steps.title: Rebase feature onto main
steps.instructions: On feature, run git rebase main and resolve the conflict in app.py.
